description: #1041 item 4: a scanf-family %s / %[ conversion with no field width is an overflow_unbounded sink. fscanf's input is a stream, so it fires unconditionally like gets() (no --source attribution); sscanf fires only while its input string (arg 0) is tainted. A width (%63[^\n]) or an untainted constant input string is never a sink. A format in writable storage (a global another path rewrites) or with %n$ positions is not guessed either way: it is a format_unchecked frontier that withholds the all-clear (#1050 review findings 1 and 4). Built with glibc's default C99 spellings (__isoc99_*).
